summary:
The aim of the project is to transfer historical and natural beauties to future generations in a healthy way and to prevent them from being permanently damaged or destroyed.

As time passes, historical and natural beauties can become deformed due to climate changes and the negative effects of human activities. If we do not prevent these negative changes, permanent and irreversible cultural and economic losses may occur.

Our project helps people who are interested in science, want to prevent permanent damage, and aim to improve their general knowledge, to learn about these subjects in an easy and clear way.

Knowing the physical changes of historical and natural beauties over time is very important for transferring these heritages to future generations, protecting them, and preventing possible risks in advance.

It is everyone's responsibility to protect and take care of the historical and natural beauties of the world. As a team, we also wanted to take care of these values, make sure that everyone can benefit from our project, and fulfill our own responsibilities.
details:
The main aim of our project is to analyze the physical changes of historical and natural beauties on Earth by using Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data.

Our project aims to monitor structural and environmental changes caused by landslides, ground subsidence, erosion, earthquake deformations, or human activities with millimeter-level precision, detect risks in advance, and provide scientific data for conservation planning decisions.

The intended impact of this project is to protect cultural and natural heritage in a sustainable way without irreversible damage, increase disaster resistance, and direct conservation budgets to the most critical areas.

The programming language of our project is Java, and we used Claude as a tool.

While developing our project, each valuable idea of our team members was carefully considered. We created this project by combining everyone's own ideas about the project.

Our team paid attention to making the project original above all.

While designing our project, we developed something different from the sources we used to collect information. We created a project that allows people who are interested in science and want to improve their general knowledge to access information easily and clearly about topics that have not been widely discussed.
